note: The four planes of the stack (ADR-0003 D2) and the docs section each one owns. check-freshness.mjs reads this: a section missing from the docs nav fails, a walkthrough named here that does not exist fails, and when a plane repository is reachable, a guide that exists in it but is not listed on the section page fails, as does a listed guide that is gone or retitled upstream. The section pages list every canonical guide and link nothing away from the product repository, because ADR-0003 D4 keeps the manual canonical there. Guide bodies are deliberately not projected into the site.
